hypothesis: Real options order-flow toxicity predicts subsequent realized volatility, and a signal-timed delta-hedged ATM straddle measured with the correct mark-path net-of-cost P&L is tradable for the BTC/ETH perpetual on the already-acquired real 7d synchronized three-way captures, tested at the HEAVIEST floor the free Deribit/OKX public API can deliver (feasible-floor replication of EVAL-62; supersedes the sealed EVAL-63 BLOCKED whose strict >=7d perp floor is physically unreachable).
extends: EVAL-62 (identical measurement, feasible pre-registered floor; EVAL-62 stays sealed/immutable)

data_availability.deribit_option_trade_retention_note: 1d/2d/3d/5d/7d lookbacks return the same trade set (~83.4ks); options order flow is 24h-capped, so no 7d options-flow floor is set
data_availability.deribit_perp_1m_candle_retention_note: MEASURED on the real 7d capture: get_tradingview_chart_data for {BTC,ETH}-PERPETUAL at 1m returns 5001 candles / 300000 s regardless of requested window, so the perp leg can never reach 7d from the free public API
data_availability.deribit_5m_candle_scaling_note: surface 5m candles DO scale to the full 7d (2017 snaps / 604800 s / 1001 5m bars)

protocol.title: Feasible-floor real options order-flow toxicity -> signal-timed delta-hedged ATM straddle with correct mark-path net-of-cost P&L on the BTC/ETH perpetual (heaviest floor the free Deribit/OKX public API can deliver)
protocol.extends: EVAL-62 (identical measurement, feasible pre-registered floor; EVAL-62 stays sealed/immutable)
protocol.supersedes: EVAL-63 (sealed BLOCKED: the strict >=7d perp floor is physically unreachable; perp 1m candles cap at 300000 s)

tox_detail.tox: (call_notional - put_notional)/(call_notional + put_notional) from real Deribit option trades per bar (EVAL-61 helper, reused)
tox_detail.imbalance: (aggressive_buy_amt - aggressive_sell_amt)/total_amt (signed aggressor variant, EVAL-61 helper, reused)

protocol.position: side_k = sign(tox_z_k); exposure_k = clip(|tox_z_k|, 0, size_cap); causal decision at bar k; delta-hedged in the perp
protocol.straddle: front-expiry common strike nearest spot, both legs priced from real marks (EVAL-57 _pick_straddle_quotes/_iv_and_greeks, reused)
protocol.pnl_per_bar: dOption_k = side_k*exposure_k*(mark_{k+1}-mark_k)*S_k; gross_k = dOption_k + hedge_k*dS_k; ret_k = (gross_k - cost_k)/S_k
protocol.duration_note: states are built with the identical EVAL-62 causal routine; on the real 7d capture the strategy is flat (side=0, ret=0) on bars without option-trade toxicity, so the extended duration enters as additional flat bars (conservative: it dilutes Sharpe, never inflates it). Only the ~24h options-order-flow overlap carries nonzero signal because Deribit tick-trade retention is ~24h.

data_availability.deribit_option_trade_retention_note: 1d/2d/3d/5d/7d lookbacks return the same trade set (~83.4ks); options order flow is 24h-capped, so no 7d options-flow floor is set
data_availability.deribit_perp_1m_candle_retention_note: MEASURED on the real 7d capture: get_tradingview_chart_data for {BTC,ETH}-PERPETUAL at 1m returns 5001 candles / 300000 s regardless of requested window, so the perp leg can never reach 7d from the free public API
data_availability.deribit_5m_candle_scaling_note: surface 5m candles DO scale to the full 7d (2017 snaps / 604800 s / 1001 5m bars)

protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: hedge_fee_bps on |dHedge|*S; half real 2-leg spread at entry/exit; full spread on side flip (identical to EVAL-57/62)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled PBO < 0.5; else NO-GO.

floor.note: order-flow span floor is a heavier-than-EVAL-62 24h bar because Deribit tick-trade retention is ~24h; surface/perp floors require the full >=7d
